title: Bedrock Enhancement
description: Make bedrock breakable! This mod adds breakable bedrock variants, bedrock tools and armor, and bedrock debris.
body:
## 中文介绍

让基岩不再无敌！本模组添加了可挖掘的基岩变体、基岩工具和护甲，以及基岩残骸方块。

### 主要特性
-  **新方块**：基岩块、准基岩块、基岩残骸、基岩门、基岩砂岩、磐基黏土、基岩砖块
-  **新物品**：基岩苹果、基岩棍、基岩准线、基岩线 
-  **基岩工具套装**：镐、剑、斧、锹、锄、基岩弓、基岩箭 
-  **基岩护甲套装**：头盔、胸甲、护腿、靴子
-  **自定义唱片**：「好想变成毛毛」（逸云/Eewin）
-  **防火属性**：所有基岩装备永不燃烧
-  **世界生成**：基岩残骸可在世界中自然生成

### 兼容性
- Minecraft Forge 1.20.1
- 兼容 JEI、Curios、GeckoLib 等常用模组

---

## English Description

Make bedrock breakable! This mod adds breakable bedrock variants, bedrock tools and armor, and bedrock debris.

### Features
-  **New Blocks**: Bedrock Block, Quasi Bedrock Block, Bedrock Debris,Bedrock Door, Bedrock Sandstone, Bedrock Clay, Bedrock Bricks
-  **New Items**: Bedrock Apple, Bedrock Stick, Bedrock String (Rough), Bedrock String
-  **Bedrock Tools**: Pickaxe, Sword, Axe, Shovel, Hoe , Bedrock Bow, Bedrock Arrow
-  **Bedrock Armor Set**: Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, Boots
-  **Custom Music Disc**: "Want to Furry Record" (by Eewin)
-  **Fire Resistance**: All bedrock gear is fire resistant
-  **World Generation**: Bedrock debris generates naturally

### Compatibility
- Minecraft Forge 1.20.1
- Compatible with JEI, Curios, GeckoLib, etc.
